test_cases.name: Phase 3 audit: comment-as-pattern false positive trong hardcoded_value_detect
test_cases.description: Phase 3 Test Fixture: P-QD2-hardcoded-value-detect phat hien comment '// deprecated value = 0.15' la hardcoded value → false positive. Bug discovered trong Phase 3 (Phien 22) va da fix ngay. Test nay verify fix khong bi regression. Audit finding: probe phai bo qua lines co prefix '//' hoac '#'.

input.scenario: Source file co comment '// deprecated tax_rate = 0.10' tren dong code co the check. Dong thuc co gia tri hardcode la 0.15 (khong co comment).

expected.comment_line_result: NO signal (comment lines phai bi skip)

test_cases.validation: Probe KHONG emit signal cho comment lines (// hoac #). Probe EMIT signal cho literal numeric values trong executable code. Fix verified: fixtures/qd2-test/negative/neg-03-comment-pattern.ts KHONG trigger signal. Audit Phien 22: bug found + fixed same session.
test_cases.audit_ref: 03-qd2-business-audit.md Phase 3 (Phien 22) — comment-as-pattern bug discovered + fixed + fixtures/qd2-test/negative/neg-03-*

test_cases.name: D9 audit: CDG governance gap — domain_expert_review khong co CDG handler
test_cases.description: Phase 2 D9: dim.json co cdg=false nhung P-QD2-domain-expert-review spawn external AI agent ma co the bi CDG-AGENT-DOWN. Khi AI agent down, probe khong co CDG handler → silent skip hoac hang. IMP-QD2-009 (P1): them CDG handler cho domain_expert_review probe.

input.scenario: P-QD2-domain-expert-review duoc chay voi profile=deep. Mock AI agent service tra ve CDG-AGENT-DOWN (503 service unavailable). Probe khong co CDG handler.

expected.current_behavior: Probe hang hoac silent skip (no CDG handler for agent down)
expected.expected_after_IMP_QD2_009: CDG handler fires: log CDG-AGENT-DOWN, skip probe gracefully, emit warning signal

test_cases.validation: TRUOC IMP-QD2-009: probe khong xuong gracefully khi AI agent down → lane hang. SAU IMP-QD2-009: CDG handler phai catch CDG-AGENT-DOWN, emit warning signal, va tiep tuc sang probe tiep theo. dim.json phai duoc cap nhat cdg=true (sau fix).
test_cases.audit_ref: 03-qd2-business-audit.md Phase 2 D9 + Phase 4 CDG governance gap

test_cases.name: CASCADE-QD2-001 CRITICAL: domain-expert bypass khi feature ngoai domain scope
test_cases.description: Phase 4 CASCADE-QD2-001 CRITICAL: Khi feature khong thuoc bat ky domain nao trong req_registry.departments, P-QD2-domain-expert-review tu dong skip → ZERO domain review cho feature. Dieu nay co nghia la feature moi co nghiep vu sai nhung khong duoc audit boi bat ky domain expert nao. IMP-QD2-011 (P2): fallback domain reviewer hoac warning cho unscoped features.

input.scenario: Registry co feature FEAT-NEWFEATURE-001 voi impl_status=done nhung khong co department tag nao khop voi danh sach domain experts (finance/sales/hr). Profile=standard.

expected.current_behavior: Probe silently skips FEAT-NEWFEATURE-001 (no domain match → no review)
expected.expected_after_IMP_QD2_011: emit warning signal: signal_type='unscoped_feature_no_review', severity='medium', evidence.feature_id='FEAT-NEWFEATURE-001'

test_cases.validation: TRUOC IMP-QD2-011: feature ngoai domain scope bi silent skip → 0% business audit coverage. SAU IMP-QD2-011: phai emit canh bao hoac assign fallback reviewer. CASCADE: probe skip → signal agg skip → QD2 report khong co findings → engineer assume business OK.
